data.title: Applied Invest Announces Strategic Investment in Integrated Power
data.description: Applied Invest has disclosed their strategic investment in Integrated Power Co. and J.A. Wever Construction, collectively known as Integrated Power, based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. Integrated Power is a top provider of electrical infrastructure services, specializing in constructing, maintaining, and offering related services for vital components of the electric grid such as substations, transmission lines, and power generation facilities. This move aims to capitalize on the expertise of Integrated Power's workforce and their integrated approach to electrical and foundation work.

data.title: UTEM Welcomes Kim Zander as Chief Executive Officer
data.description: In Hewitt, Texas, on September 14, 2026, UTEM, a company specializing in manufacturing aerial lift trucks, revealed that Kim Zander has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer. Zander, known for her experience in organizational management, is set to lead the company into its future endeavors.

data.title: GAC Commercial Vehicle Accelerates Global Expansion with IAA TRANSPORTATION 2026 Debut
data.description: In Hanover, Germany on September 14, 2026, GAC Commercial Vehicle made their debut at IAA TRANSPORTATION 2026 with the theme "Delivering the Future Together." The event featured displays of products, technologies, and open-ecosystem advancements in their new-energy heavy and light commercial vehicles.

data.title: The Cooper Companies (NASDAQ: COO) Scrutinized Over U.S. Channel Inventory Reductions Driving Stock Sharply Lower -- HBSS
data.description: On September 14, 2026, shareholders of The Cooper Companies, Inc. (NASDAQ: COO) experienced a significant decline in share value as prices dropped by $9.31, marking a 14.6% decrease following the company's release of its Q3 2026 financial report. The results disclosed details regarding the company's actions to reduce U.S. channel inventory levels, impacting investor confidence and leading to the drop in share prices.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Modified Steering Wheel System for Vehicles (CHK-5031)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 14, 2026, an inventor from St. Louis, Missouri shared their inspiration for creating the DOUBLE, a device that enables driving from the passenger seat. The inventor, who underwent knee surgery and was unable to drive for six weeks due to limited mobility in the right leg, identified a need for this innovative solution. This invention aims to provide an alternative for individuals facing similar mobility challenges. The DOUBLE offers a potential solution for those who require assistance in driving due to physical limitations, showcasing the inventiveness and adaptability of individuals in overcoming obstacles.

data.title: Bitmine acquires $68M ETH, nearing 6M total. Aim is 5% of supply ownership with majority earning staking rewards.
data.description: The recent acquisition moves the company closer to its target of possessing 5% of the total Ethereum supply, and a majority of these tokens are eligible for staking rewards.

data.title: Prime IV Hydration & Wellness Expands Personalized Wellness Offerings with BHRT and Niagen®
data.description: In Colorado Springs on September 14, 2026, Prime IV Hydration & Wellness announced an expansion of their services to cater to clients seeking flexible and personalized support in managing their physical and mental well-being as they age. As the top IV therapy franchise in the country, they are now offering a wider range of advanced wellness options to meet the growing demand. This expansion is set to provide clients with more ways to address their feelings, functionality, and overall aging process.

data.title: NASDAQ: TBLA INVESTOR ALERT: Berger Montague Advises Taboola.com Ltd. (NASDAQ: TBLA) Investors of an October 20, 2026 Deadline
data.description: A prominent plaintiff law firm, Berger Montague, has revealed the initiation of a class action lawsuit against Taboola.com Ltd. (NASDAQ: TBLA) on September 14, 2026. The lawsuit represents investors who obtained Taboola securities within a specified timeframe. Taboola, a company under scrutiny, is facing legal action due to alleged misconduct related to its securities transactions. This move underscores the significant impact of the case on investors and the financial industry as a whole. The lawsuit highlights the importance of regulatory compliance and transparency in the securities market, emphasizing the need for accountability and protection of investor interests.

data.title: DIAGNOS to Hold its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on September 30, 2026
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Diagnos Inc. ("DIAGNOS") disclosed plans for its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders to take place on September 30, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., at Alt Quartier DIX30 Hotel in Brossard, Quebec. The corporation, known for its employment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the early detection of eye-related health issues, will convene to address key agendas. Shareholders and stakeholders can attend in person at the specified location: 6500 de Rome Blvd, 2nd floor, Brossard, QC, J4Y 0B6. DIAGNOS trades on the TSX Venture exchange under the symbol ADK, on the OTCQB as DGNOF, and on the FWB as 4D4A.
FAQs regarding reorganization scheduled for September 2026 are now available to the public.
